g.text: 01 SHADOW / INK-BOUND GAUGE R01
UNAPPROVED • PLACEHOLDER ONLY • NO BRAND ARTWORK

INK BOUNDING BOX — 82.000 x 18.629 mm
Based on recorded PNG alpha bounding box [4,4,2491,569].
This is a blank envelope, not an accurate silhouette or supplier proof.
SEPARATE CUT-OUT: SAME ENVELOPE
Place on actual garment: compare wearer-left chest vs center front.
Do not interpret this as approved placement, size, or print method.
MEASUREMENT RECORD
Reference bar: ______ mm Ink envelope: ______ x ______ mm
Garment size: ______ Placement: LEFT / CENTER / UNDECIDED

Caution: 82mm is physical INK width. If vendor scales full 2500px canvas,

Vendor alpha-trim and actual print behavior are UNVERIFIED.
NO VENDOR UPLOAD • NO ORDER • NO PRINT APPROVAL
